description: This file is a module script used for managing and testing extensions within a larger project. It includes functions for resolving extension directories, generating test plans, batching tests, and creating test shards, as well as importing various project-specific configurations and utilities.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Normalizes a file path to use forward slashes regardless of OS-specific separator.

methods.name: countTestFiles
methods.description: Counts the number of test files (.test.ts, .test.tsx) in a directory hierarchy.

methods.name: resolveExtensionDirectory
methods.description: Resolves the directory of an extension, given optional target argument, considering the project structure.

methods.name: resolveExtensionTestPlan
methods.description: Generates a test plan for a specific extension, including its configuration, root directories, and test file count.

methods.name: mergeTestPlans
methods.description: Merges multiple test plans into a grouped plan with combined extension IDs and roots.

methods.name: resolveExtensionBatchPlan
methods.description: Creates a combined plan for multiple extensions, based on their individual test plans.

methods.name: pickLeastLoadedShard
methods.description: Selects the index of the shard with the least load based on test file count and plan count.

methods.name: createExtensionTestShards
methods.description: Distributes extensions into multiple shards for parallel testing, trying to balance load.
